ChildStartupPhaseTests.test_text_reconci.obsolete: It times the stages of the SQLite text index's startup reconcile (PRKSTextIndex._reconcile_all_inner), which only server._sqlite_startup_maintenance runs. A PostgreSQL server runs no startup text reconcile: each adopted PDF queues a text job for the worker, and a gap in the derived rows schedules a repair job (tests/pg/test_search_rebuild.py::RepairTests), so there are no startup_text_* phases to record.

A PostgreSQL server runs no startup text reconcile: each adopted PDF queues a text job for the worker, and a gap in the derived rows schedules a repair job (tests/pg/test_search_rebuild.py::RepairTests), so there are no startup_text_* phases to record. The extractor availability probe is the text job's own (tests/pg/test_search_text.py::ExtractionTests.test_a_missing_extractor_records_no_outcome).
